intentAndPurpose.intent: Primary mobile-app navigation landmark for 2–5 top-level destinations. Product code supplies BottomNavItem children; the parent owns one controlled or uncontrolled current value and renders a horizontal Base UI toolbar inside <nav>.

props.name: children
props.description: Two to five <BottomNavItem> children. Transparent Fragment nesting is supported; the Figma `items` axis describes the flattened item count and is intentionally not a React prop.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Role for active icon tint and interaction states. auto inherits the nearest Surface appearance, then falls back to primary.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test id forwarded to the root <nav>.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial current destination for uncontrolled navigation.

props.name: labelType
props.description: Label layout shared by the items. Compatibility mapping: Figma 1Line / 2Line / none → React 1line / 2line / none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the activated item value.

props.name: showDivider
props.description: Show the decorative horizontal Divider at the top edge (size S, low emphasis).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled current destination value. Matching is singular and authoritative over item-level active compatibility props.

codeSnippets.title: Basic Usage
codeSnippets.code:
import { BottomNavigation, BottomNavItem } from '@oneui/ui';

<BottomNavigation aria-label="Primary navigation" defaultValue="home">
  <BottomNavItem value="home" icon="home" label="Home" />
  <BottomNavItem value="search" icon="search" label="Search" />
</BottomNavigation>

interactionBehavior.summary: BottomNavigation is a Base UI Toolbar inside a `<nav>` landmark, not a set of independent tab stops: only one item is in the tab order at a time, arrows rove, and `Home` / `End` jump to the ends. Selection is singular — parent `value` / `defaultValue` wins over any item `active` prop, and `aria-current="page"` is applied to exactly one item. Hover and press fills are injected by this container from the surrounding Surface's tint (`--{SurfaceRole}-Hover` / `--Pressed`), not from the nav's own accent role, so a primary-accent bar on a page canvas still gets a Neutral state layer.
hover: The container does not paint a bar-level hover. It only supplies `--_bn-state-hover` on the `<nav>` from the nearest Surface's appearance and step — Neutral on a page-like canvas, the Surface role on a tinted ancestor — so child items can tint without following the nav accent.
Dark `default` (~200) is treated as a real tinted step, not a page canvas, so the state layer stays in that Surface role rather than flipping to Neutral.
Item hover fills themselves live on BottomNavItem and are `(hover: hover)`-guarded there.
press: Same split as hover: the `<nav>` injects `--_bn-state-pressed` from the surrounding Surface role; the pressed fill and icon scale-up are painted by BottomNavItem.
The decorative top Divider is `pointer-events: none` and absolutely overlaid, so it never steals the press from the equal-width item columns underneath.
focus: The `<nav>` itself is not focusable. Keyboard focus lands on one BottomNavItem at a time via Base UI Toolbar's roving `tabIndex`.
The two-layer halo is painted by BottomNavItem on its inner pill, not on this landmark.
keyboard: Base UI Toolbar owns `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` (logical in RTL), wrapping (`loopFocus`), disabled-item skipping, and roving `tabIndex`. Arrows move focus only — they do not change the active item.
`Home` / `End` are OneUI, not Base UI: a keydown on the toolbar jumps focus to the first / last enabled `[data-bottom-navigation-item]` and `preventDefault`s. They also do not select.
The roving tab stop seeds on the active enabled item; if that item is `disabled`, it falls back to the first enabled item rather than trapping Tab on a dead control.
`Enter` / `Space` activate the focused item (button or link) and then update `value`. Disabled items are skipped by arrows and are not tabbable (`focusableWhenDisabled={false}`).
Non-`BottomNavItem` children are omitted from the toolbar entirely, so they never enter the arrow path.
selected: Exactly one item is current. Parent `value` / `defaultValue` is authoritative; item-level `active` is only read when the parent has no selection, and even then the first `active` item wins.
The current item is `aria-current="page"` plus `[data-active]` and `[data-composite-item-active]`. Duplicate `value`s still resolve to the first match, so `aria-current` stays singular.
Active styling (label `--{Role}-High`, icon `--{Role}-TintedA11y`, optional `activeIcon` swap) is painted by BottomNavItem — this container has no selected fill of its own.
touch: Each item is `flex: 1` across the bar, so the hit target is the whole equal-width column (height `--Spacing-14` / `--Spacing-16` / `--Spacing-18` by `labelType`), not the icon glyph.
Item hover fills are `(hover: hover)`-guarded on BottomNavItem; a tap's response is the pressed inner-pill fill plus the icon scale-up.
